title: Vibrates, noisier than expected
text: Vibrates, noisier than expected. Vibrates, (fan isn't balanced) pushes alot of air. For the price, it's noisy, I expected a smooth running, much quieter fan

product_metadata.title: Hurricane Stand Fan - 20 Inch, Pro Series, High Velocity, Heavy Duty Metal For Industrial, Commercial, Residential, & Greenhouse Use - ETL Listed, Black
features: The Hurricane Pro 20 Inch High Velocity Metal Stand Fan is ideal for homes, greenhouses, gyms, garages, workshops and other areas that may need a heavy duty wall fan; helps ventilate fumes and stagnant air
HEAVY DUTY: Features a rugged all-metal construction, aluminum fan blades, and a black powder-coated finish; sturdy, weighted base helps the fan remain securely upright
HIGH VELOCITY: Features 3 speed settings, oscillating and adjustable tilt for changing airflow direction; runs at an airflow of 4500 CFM and 1400 RPM
ADJUSTABLE HEIGHT: You can easily extend the of height of the fan from 39 inches up to 54 inches; measures 21 in. x 55 in. x 20 in. at full height
ETL Certified: The ETL listing is a mark of the industry’s safety and quality standards in North America
description: The Hurricane® Pro 20 inch High Velocity Oscillating Metal Stand Fan is made to last for many seasons. This high-speed fan is ideal for homes, greenhouses, garages, workshops and other areas where a heavy-duty portable stand fan can be used for a reliable and steady flow of air. As an industry leader in industrial fans and quality construction, these heavy-duty Hurricane Fans have a rugged all-metal build, with heavy-duty aluminum fan blades and a black powder-coated finish. Its 3 speed settings, oscillation and adjustable tilt allow you to customize the combination of speed and airflow for ideal ventilation in any space. It has an adjustable height from 39 inches up to 54 inches tall with a round sturdy weighted base to help your fan remain securely upright. Runs at 1450 RPM with an airflow of 4500 CFM on high. Comes with a 6 ft 120 V power cord. ETL listed.
